A timeline spanning the year 1993 from left to right. Key dates marked with text boxes above and below the line: "June 12: Presidential election held", "June 23: Election annulled by the military", "August 26: Babangida steps aside; ING formed under Shonekan", "November 10: High Court declares ING illegal", "November 17: Shonekan resigns; Abacha takes over".

A flowchart showing the transfer of power in 1993. Top box: "General Ibrahim Babangida (Military Rule)". An arrow points down to a middle box: "Chief Ernest Shonekan (Interim National Government)". Another arrow points down to a bottom box: "General Sani Abacha (Military Rule)".
